items.name: HORN (queer techno club, Silom Soi 4)
items.venue: HORN, 4th floor, 71-73 Silom Soi 4, Bang Rak
items.coordSource: google-maps-listing (HORN, 13.7284285, 100.5329614) + osm nightclub node 13844079924 (4 m apart); address matches RA club 259996
items.gmapsQuery: HORN, 71-73 Silom Soi 4, Bang Rak, Bangkok
items.description: Small, dark techno club on the 4th floor of a building on Silom Soi 4, for about 200 people. It is queer-run and open to all; resident and guest DJs play techno with electro, acid and some house, and Time Out compares it to a Berlin basement. Berlin queer parties come here too: GEGEN (Apr and Oct 2026) and REMEDY with the Herrensauna founders (14 Nov 2026).
items.recurrence: Thursday to Saturday, 22:00-03:00. Thursdays are usually FEED (techno); weekend nights change between BUNKER techno nights, LAB (open format), house nights and visiting crews. In your dates: Fri 8, Sat 9, Thu 14, Fri 15, Sat 16, Thu 21, Fri 22 and Sat 23 Jan.
items.priceText: Usually 500 THB at the door with 2 drinks (RA, 2026); guest nights 400-750 THB; GEGEN was 900 THB in dress code, 1,200 THB without.
tips: 20+ only. Bring your passport.

Some nights are queer fetish parties with a dress code and a no-photo rule. At GEGEN (Oct 2026) the code was fetish, latex, leather, sportswear or skin, and entry was cheaper in dress code. Ask before you touch anyone.
Themed nights are often announced at short notice on Instagram @horn.th (Time Out). RA lists most nights.
Elsewhere and DUAL in Trinity Complex are about 0.5 km away in a straight line, so you can move on after 03:00.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. RA GraphQL: club 259996 (capacity 200, not closed, 'raw, bunker-style club... queer space open to all'); 142 RA nights Dec 2025-Nov 2026, 132 of them Thu-Sat, mostly 22:00-03:00 and 500 THB; Jan 2026 had FEED on Thursdays and BUNKER on Fridays and Saturdays. GEGEN x HORNBKK 24 Oct 2026: 900/1,200 THB, dress code, no photos. REMEDY 14 Nov 2026: two floors, 400-900 THB. Google Maps: Thu-Sat 22:00-03:00, 4.8 (78 reviews). Time Out page dated 7 Mar 2026; Loopliner guide 12 Aug 2026. No January 2027 line-ups yet.

items.name: SACRISTY hard techno raves
items.venue: Changes per party: in 2026 mostly DUAL (Trinity Complex basement, Silom) or AVVE (25 Edison Alley, Phra Khanong)
items.coordSource: google-maps-listing for DUAL, the most common 2026 venue; the other venue, AVVE, is at 13.71445, 100.59401
items.gmapsQuery: DUAL, Trinity Complex, Soi Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 3, Bangkok
items.description: Bangkok crew that throws dark hard techno raves about once a month: hard techno, hardgroove, industrial, bochka and schranz, lit only by strobes and a few lights. In 2026 the parties ran at DUAL (Funktion-One) and AVVE, with guests such as Rorganic, Gemüt (Monasterio), Axciid and cassandrah. It is the closest Bangkok gets to a hard Bassiani-style night, but no January 2027 date is out yet.
items.recurrence: About once a month on a Friday or Saturday, 21:00-04:00. 2026 nights: 20 and 28 Mar, 15 May, 26 Jun, 24 Jul, 29 Aug, 19 Sep, 30 and 31 Oct, 7 Nov. No date for 8-26 Jan 2027 yet.
items.priceText: 350-700 THB in 2026 (RA); 600 THB at the door in Aug 2026 (Time Out).
tips: Watch Instagram @sacristy.bangkok and the RA promoter page for a January date.
20+ only. Bring your passport.
At DUAL one ticket covers both dance floors (RA, Nov 2026).
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. RA GraphQL promoter 175241 ('a techno sanctuary for the inner circle... raw techno and dark groove'): 11 events from 19 Dec 2025 to 7 Nov 2026, 5 at AVVE, 5 at DUAL, 1 at a secret venue; prices 350-700 THB; Halloween 30-31 Oct 2026 at DUAL and AVVE; 7 Nov 2026 Axciid x cassandrah at DUAL (700 THB). Time Out 26 Aug 2026: Gemüt at DUAL, 600 THB, 21:00-04:00. No Sacristy event listed for Dec 2026 or Jan 2027 on RA. The January date is not announced, so dates are left empty.

items.name: Elsewhere (after-hours room, Trinity Complex)
items.venue: Elsewhere, 9th floor, Trinity Complex, Soi Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 3, Silom

items.description: Tiny after-hours room on the 9th floor of Trinity Complex in Silom, opened in late 2024 by three brothers. Asian and local selectors play techno, house and minimal on a Danley and JBL sound system, from midnight to dawn. It fills up after 2 or 3 am and works mostly by word of mouth.
items.recurrence: Fridays and Saturdays from 23:00 (busy after 02:00) until 04:00-06:00. In your dates: Fri 8, Sat 9, Fri 15, Sat 16, Fri 22 and Sat 23 Jan. In January 2026 it also opened on some Tuesday to Thursday nights.
items.timeText: Fri-Sat 23:00-04:00 on Google Maps and Time Out; RA nights usually run 23:00-06:00 ('midnight to dawn')
items.priceText: 400 THB on most RA listings, 500 THB for some guest nights (2026).
tips: DUAL is in the basement of the same building: start there at 21:00 and go up after midnight.
Bring cash. Loopliner says Elsewhere may not take cards.
20+ only. Line-ups on Instagram @elsewhere425 and RA.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. RA GraphQL club 255279 (capacity 100, not closed, 'FRI & SAT - MIDNIGHT TO DAWN'): 97 nights Dec 2025-Oct 2026, 86 on Fri-Sat, 400 THB on 73 of them, mostly 23:00-06:00; Jan 2026 also had nights on Tue 13, Wed 14 and Thu 15 Jan. tips: Elsewhere (9th floor, same building) opens around midnight, so you can do both in one night.

20+ only. Line-ups on Instagram @dualbkk and RA.

items.name: SUBWERK (hard techno club, Rave Times nights)

items.description: Hard techno room in the Mustache building on Decho Road, for about 350 people, run by the Rave Times crew. Every Friday and Saturday it plays hard techno and hard dance at 150-160 BPM, with guests from Berlin's KitKat and Tresor circles and some psytrance nights. No tables and no dress code, except on theme nights.
items.recurrence: Fridays and Saturdays 22:00-03:00. In your dates: Fri 8, Sat 9, Fri 15, Sat 16, Fri 22 and Sat 23 Jan.
tips: 20+. A real passport or ID card is checked at the door (RA).
Theme nights can have a strict dress code: Kinky Halloween (30 Oct 2026) required fetish, leather or dark wear.
Mustache (house and melodic techno) is in the same building if your group wants to split.
Dates are posted on ravetimesth.com and the Rave Times Facebook page.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. RA GraphQL club 268814 (capacity 350, 'weekly hard Techno and Psy Trance events'): 81 nights Dec 2025-Oct 2026, 74 on Fri-Sat, 300 THB on 69, 22:00-03:00 on 75; in Aug 2026 three nights ran at a temporary site next to MUIN Club, then back on Decho Rd. tips: Fridays and Saturdays run to 03:00; other nights end at 01:00.
No dress code and often no cover (Loopliner).

items.name: OUTWORLD: Klangkuenstler all night long at FVTURE
items.venue: FVTURE Bangkok, 5th-6th floor, Bravo BKK, 99/6-9 Rim Khlong Bang Kapi Road, RCA area (Huai Khwang)

items.description: German hard techno DJ Klangkuenstler brings his OUTWORLD show to Thailand for the first time and plays all night; it is the only Southeast Asia date in 2027. It is a no-photo, no-video night: staff put a sticker on your phone camera. FVTURE is a 6,000-capacity club in a shopping mall that has been closed since mid-February 2026, so check that it reopens before you plan around this.
items.priceText: Tier 2 (final release) 2,150 THB on Ticketmelon; Early Bird 1,950 THB and Tier 1 2,050 THB are sold out (21 Oct 2026).
tips: 20+ only. Bring your passport.
Sat 23 Jan is the last Koh Phangan night for the two of you who go there.
Google Maps marks FVTURE as temporarily closed. Buy only on Ticketmelon and watch @fvture.bkk for news about the reopening.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. Ticketmelon page and its page data: show times 1800709200000-1800738000000 ms = Sat 23 Jan 2027 20:00 to Sun 24 Jan 04:00 Bangkok time, Must be 20+, no-photo/no-video with camera stickers, tiers 1,950 and 2,050 sold out, 2,150 THB on sale; venue = Google place of FVTURE Bangkok. Hard techno, hard groove, schranz and hard bounce at 140-160 BPM, with resident Sam Laxton and a guest most weeks, under a laser rig. It is a cheap, loud night with free beer early, not a curated Berlin-style club.

items.priceText: 300-500 THB in 2026 listings, with free or unlimited beer 22:00-00:00; after midnight entry includes 1 drink (RA, INAKOMA site).

items.name: Culture Cafe (nightly vinyl techno sessions, Banglamphu)

items.description: Bar and party hostel in the old town that has a vinyl DJ session every night, with free entry. Most nights are minimal, house and techno; Friday is HARD EDGE, dark and industrial hard techno with EBM. Its RA page traces it back to Café Democ in 1999.
items.recurrence: Every night 20:00-03:00. Mon and Wed: plazdj vinyl sessions. Tue: MOODYBOOM / Highwire crew. Thu: Thursday Tech on Wax and guests. Fri: HARD EDGE. Sat: Krit Morton and guests. Sun: G2G house and techno. In your dates: every night from 8 to 26 Jan.
items.priceText: Free entry; cocktails about 180 THB (RA).
tips: Free entry every night, so it is an easy first stop or a cheap weeknight.
Friday HARD EDGE is the night for your taste: dark industrial techno, EBM and electro, by TheThirdTechno.
20+ on RA listings.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. items.description: Record store by day that becomes a listening bar at night, playing house, techno and other club music for about 60 people. Local DJs and crews such as Elektronik play from 21:00 to midnight, and most nights are free.
items.recurrence: Thursday to Sunday 12:00-00:00, Wednesday 12:00-20:00, closed Mon-Tue (Google). DJ nights mostly Thu-Sat 21:00-00:00. In your dates: 8, 9, 10, 14, 15, 16, 17, 21, 22, 23 and 24 Jan.
items.priceText: Most nights free (22 of 26 RA listings in 2026); special nights 100-150 THB.
tips: A good place to buy house and techno records during the day.
It closes at midnight; Mustache and SUBWERK on Decho Road are the nearest late options.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. items.name: ÆTHER BKK (44th-floor rooftop bar with DJ nights)
items.venue: ÆTHER BKK, 44th floor, Central Park Offices (Dusit Central Park), 92 Rama IV Road, Silom

items.description: 360-degree rooftop cocktail bar on the 44th floor above Silom, with house and tech house most nights. Some nights have known guest DJs, such as the More Rice Records 9th anniversary (31 Oct 2026), and it sells tickets for the Beatforest festival. A smart-casual rooftop bar, not a club.
items.recurrence: Daily 17:00-02:00, last orders 01:00 (official site). DJ events on some Fridays and Saturdays. In your dates: every night from 8 to 26 Jan.
items.priceText: Entry 600 THB Sun-Thu; Fri, Sat and holidays 600 THB for the sunset session (17:00-20:30, drink credit) and 800 THB with 1 drink after 21:00; tables from 5,000 THB minimum spend (official site). Special events 1,000-1,200 THB (RA).
tips: Smart casual: no beachwear, torn clothes or shirtless men (official site).
HORN is about 430 m away for later.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. aetherbkk.com: daily 17:00-02:00, entry and minimum-spend rules as above, smart casual, house and tech house. items.description: A full live band plays Daft Punk songs with the helmets and a big light show; Bangkok is the last night of its Thailand tour. Fun with a group, but it is a tribute show, not a club night.

items.description: A four-deck boat for about 300 people on the river, with DJs, live bands and themed nights from Wednesday to Sunday; Saturdays are often river cruises. The music is mixed: reggae, indie, afro house and psytrance. On Fri 8 Jan it hosts Chant Down Babylon, a live reggae and roots night.
items.recurrence: Wednesday to Sunday 18:00-00:00 (Google). Wed: free DJ community night. Thu: Terra Canta (world and electro, free). Fri: promoter party on the top deck. Sat: big party, usually a cruise. Sun: flea market. In your dates: 8, 9, 10, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 20, 21, 22, 23 and 24 Jan.
items.timeText: Wed-Sun 18:00-00:00 (Google Maps); Chant Down Babylon Fri 8 Jan 18:00-23:30
items.priceText: Several weekly nights free; Chant Down Babylon 799 THB early bird, 899 THB at the door (Eventpop).
tips: Most nights are docked at the pier; check bangkokisland.com for which nights cruise.
This is a sunset and boat outing, not a techno night.

items.name: Muuji Festival 2027 (Japanese-style pop and indie festival, Khao Yai)
items.venue: Thong Somboon Club, Pak Chong, Khao Yai (Nakhon Ratchasima), about 170 km by road from central Bangkok

items.description: One-day festival with more than 20 Thai and Japanese pop, rock and indie acts, a fun-fair zone and a large VIP area; it is the 5th edition. It is the only music festival in or near Bangkok in your dates, but it is not dance music.
items.priceText: 850 THB (800 THB each for 2 or more), Super VIP 2,500 THB (musicfestival.in.th); the official site sold early tickets at 899/850 THB on 4-19 Oct 2026.
tips: About 2 h 15 min by car from central Bangkok without traffic (OSRM, 172 km).
Skip it unless someone in the group likes Japanese pop and rock.
items.verification: Checked 21 Oct 2026. muujifestival.com: 23 Jan 2027, Thongsomboon Club Khaoyai, more than 20 Thai and Japanese artists, early sales 4-19 Oct 2026 at 899/850 THB. musicfestival.in.th: Pop, Indie, ticket tiers as above, amusement zone and VIP village. TicketTail page: 5th anniversary, 5 stages. Every festival page in the musicfestival.in.th sitemap was read: the only other one in 8-26 Jan is Huay Rai Arena (16-17 Jan, Sakon Nakhon, folk), far from Bangkok.
